Context: 1. Not admissible to-

## 1. Not admissible to-  
- Employees who have been provided with facility of Government
- (i) transport.
- (ii) Employees during absence from duty for a full calendar month due to leave/ training/ tour, etc. If the absence covers more than one month, it will not be admissible for calendar month(s) wholly covered by absence. If the absence covers part of any calendar month, it will be admissible for the full month.
